sections.title: باب 7 — متن (52)

If he was attempting a point and the point is made, the goal will be accepted, and if not, then three free throws will be given. The personal foul will be recorded in the name of the player.

sections.theory:
Penalty

If the foul is committed by such a player as was not throwing the ball for a point, then a side throw will be given. If he was attempting a point and the point is made, the goal will be accepted, and if not, then three free throws will be given. The personal foul will be recorded in the name of the player.

Intentional foul

That personal foul which is done deliberately and whose intensity is more than an ordinary personal foul is called an intentional foul. Ignoring the ball and colliding physically with the opposing player is called an intentional foul.

Penalty

A foul will be recorded in the name of the player. The opponent will get 2 free throws.

Double foul

When two opposing players commit a foul against each other at the same time, it will be called a double foul. The game will start again with a jump ball and no free throw will be given.

Technical foul of a player

Such a breach of rules as is done intentionally and benefits the one committing the foul illegally is called a technical foul. A technical foul will be given in the following cases.

Indecent behaviour with some official.

Creating delay in the game without reason.

Using such words for the opposing player as hurt his feelings.

Not raising the hand when the foul is committed.
